elements.element: Renewal is automatic for 12-month (1-year) terms (alternative permitted path to mutual written agreement)
elements.evidence: "This Agreement will automatically renew for additional 1-year terms"

elements.element: Customer may opt out of automatic renewal on 30 days' notice
elements.evidence: "unless Customer gives 30 days' notice of non-renewal"
"Kubient shall notify Customer at least 60 days before the end of each term of the upcoming automatic renewal"

elements.element: Renewal price increases capped at the lesser of CPI and 3%
elements.evidence: "any price increase for a renewal term shall not exceed the lesser of CPI and 3%"

elements.element: Non-renewal notice window no more than 60 days

elements.evidence: "shall not exceed the lesser of CPI and 3%"

reasons: All four atomic preferred elements are present in operative text: 1-year automatic renewals, a Customer 30-day non-renewal opt-out, a Kubient 60-day pre-renewal reminder, and a renewal price cap at the lesser of CPI and 3%.

The redline is minimal: one short insertion into the renewal sentence plus one concise new subsection supplying the absent reminder and price-cap mechanics; no whole-clause rewrite and no fallback-only terms imported.

Untouched commercial terms (90-day post-Initial-Term termination, breach cure, insolvency triggers, Kubient's fee entitlement) remain effective; no undefined terms or dangling mechanics introduced — 'Customer' and 'Term' are already defined.
